# agent-friendly-site

> Demo multi-merchant agent-first platform. One host, one shop per subdirectory. Shops are agent-only: no human shopping UI.

## Platform
- [Shops JSON](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/openapi.json)
- [Platform agent card](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/.well-known/agent.json)
- [Discovery test](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/DISCOVERY.md)

## Shops
- [Bean Bloom Coffee llms.txt](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/llms.txt)
- [Paper Lantern Stationery llms.txt](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/llms.txt)
- [Terra Pots Ceramics llms.txt](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/llms.txt)

## Discovery
- Give an agent a shop URL, e.g. https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/
- Agent fetches {shop}/llms.txt first, then {shop}/openapi.json, {shop}/agent.json, {shop}/api/products.json, {shop}/policies.json.
- In production, {shop}/mcp is POST Streamable HTTP. On GitHub Pages it is documented in {shop}/mcp.json only — Pages is static-only, see README.md.
